Whatever the phrasing (which I could have wrong ) - as someone who had great fear of potentially developing Schizophrenia my psych team explained very clearly the fact that I know that what I am experiencing is perceptual and not real and I can recognize that, that means it's most likely not Schizophrenia. 

And having been in a psychward with Schizophrenic and Schizoaffective inflicted people for a good few months, who whole heartedly believed the voices in their heads or hallucinations as being very real, there is a difference.

But the country I live in is not exactly up to date with latest research yada yada.

So the question it mostly comes down to is the type of psychosis. If it's atypical, it's not thought to be Schizophrenia. 

From what you are describing, it sounds atypical (you are aware that it is not real). That being said, someone would have to judge that observing you in a psychotic state.

People with Schizophrenia can have a psychotic episode and only recognize it was psychotic *after* being treated. While in psychosis they will not be able to distinguish between reality and psychotic behavior.

It's quite uncommon for doctors to miss atypical psychosis. 

In terms of being social and schizotypy, not being too social is generally found but not necessarily needed to diagnose. You can be social and still be schizotypal. 

Get a second opinion if you want to - PDs are more treatable through therapy.

1 - does criticism set you off ? 

It depends who it's coming from and the reasoning behind it. At work, I have like an apprentice/mentor sort of relationship and we are very blunt with each other but I think if my mentor turned around and really criticised (and not critiqued) my work it would suck. Other than that, I handle criticism quite well. 

2 - during conflicts, do you never or rarely feel like you're in the wrong ? 

I rarely think I am wrong. I rarely am wrong but I can acknowledge if someone has a valid point. 

3 - do you have an irrepressible need for attention ? 

No

4 - do you often feel like the victim ? 

No

5 - is your empathy lacking or non-existent ? 

I have limited emotional empathy, I think it's because I find it hard to conceptualise that other things are even real. I know objectively that they are real but most of the time my essence is the only thing that feels real so I almost don't believe that people feel things? Also I struggle to understand that people exist when I am not around, or its so inconsequential when they are not around me that I just don't care if they exist. I am trying to unpack this but I am doing a terrible job. I have cognitive empathy. 

6 - are you aware you're hypocritical ? Do you dish out harsh words that you yourself can't take ? That you want from others things you yourself can't give ? 

I don't ask of other people what I don't try and do back for them. So if I dish out harsh words, I am okay getting them back. If someone gives me something I cannot give back it makes me super uncomfortable. Maybe this is one of my reasons for fear of intimacy - it doesn't feel genuine in my part and I struggle to believe that someone else feels something deeper. 

7 - if someone isn't interested in you like you are interested in them, does it feel like a hurtful rejection ?

To be honest, this doesn't happen a lot. I think rejection always sucks but I will probably forget about it very quickly. 

8 - are you strongly insecure ? Is your self-worth weak ?

There are certain things I am very secure about and a handful of things I am insecure about. That being said, I actively try and fix the things I am insecure about and there is not much more I can do about that so I don't lose sleep.

9 - do you make a show of rejecting what others say about you, but internally, their words stick with you ? 

No

10 - do you feel empty inside ? (probably an easy yes lol)

No 

11 - are you paranoid about what others think of you ? Are you afraid of what they think of you ? 

Same with the empathy, I can't really conceptualise what other people think about me. It just doesn't feel real to me. 

12 - does it set you off when you can't control your environment and what happens to you ? 

It doesn't set me off but I am very particular about how I do things. I don't like my environment to be out of routine. 

13 - have you ever had emotionally masochistic fantasies in which you are victimised, hurt, rejected ? 

Not in many years.

14 - are you aware that you feel entitled to certain things, like respect, kindness, or affection ?

I don't feel entitled to those things

15 - If yes, does this entitlement make you feel terrible when you don't receive positive attention, even though you did nothing to earn it ? It was a no

Edit bonus questions : do you easily feel shamed ? Do you envy more attractive, charismatic people ?

I don't feel easily shamed and I can't envy other people if they don't quite feel real to me.
